track.heading: See where your shipment is without a status call
track.subtitle: Enter the tracking number to see the current status, latest update, and next step recorded by the shipping company.
track.mockNotice: This is sample data for demonstration purposes only.
track.privacyNote: The tracking page shows shipment status and only the details needed to identify it. We do not show a full address or unmasked phone number.
track.emptyInputError: Enter the tracking number you received from the merchant or shipping company.
track.formatError: Tracking numbers need at least 5 letters or digits. Example: TRK-240502-A1B2
track.notFoundDescription: Check the number exactly as it appears in the merchant message. If it is correct, the shipping company may not have registered the shipment yet.
track.errorDescription: We could not reach the tracking service right now. Try again, or return to the link the merchant sent later.
track.retryHint: Edit the number or search for the same shipment again.
track.recoveryTitle: Quick checks before the next attempt
track.recoveryCheckNumber: Confirm the tracking number exactly as the merchant or shipping company sent it.
track.recoveryCheckFormat: Check the number format, for example: TRK-240502-A1B2.
track.recoveryNewShipment: If the shipment is new, wait a little and try again.
track.recoveryContact: Contact the merchant or support if the problem continues.
track.lookupCardTitle: Enter the number exactly as it appears in the shipping message
track.timelineDescription: Each update appears as the shipping company records it from the warehouse or courier.
track.customerPrivacy: We protect customer data by masking the phone number and showing only the details needed for tracking.
